columns.name: AI_DISMISSED_RECOMS_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the dismissed Recommendation, System generated value

columns.name: AI_RECOMS_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context from where the recommendation is dismissed

columns.name: DISMISSED_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Reference Id for the dismissed entity Ex: Candidate Person Id

columns.name: SOURCE_ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Represents Source Entity type from where the recommendation is dismissed Ex: Requisition

columns.name: SOURCE_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Reference Id for the source entity. Ex: Requisition id

columns.name: REQUESTOR_ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Requestor entity type , who is dismissing the recommendation. Possible values are PERSON , REQUISITION

columns.name: REQUESTOR_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Person Id of the logged in user who has dismissed the candidate

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Dismissed reason. References to lookup code ORA_AI_DISMISS_RECOMS_REASON for dismissed reason

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
